description: Change one schedule by id: client, items, currency, cadence, dates, due_days, notes or auto_generate. Only the fields you pass change. Periods already invoiced are never re-issued, so a new amount applies to future ones.

every.description: How often to bill: "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "yearly", or {days: 10}. Month steps keep the start date's day of month and clamp it to shorter months, so a schedule starting on the 31st bills on the 28th/29th in February and back on the 31st in March

quantity.description: Hours, units or 1 for a flat fee

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for this line, overrides the business default

unit_price.description: Price per unit in major units, e.g. 90 for 90 EUR

tax_note.description: Replace the tax reason carried onto every future generated invoice. Pass an empty string to clear it

name: schedule_update
title: Update a schedule
